name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands. As a teenager, the roar of the engines and the electric atmosphere of the Welsh Rally sparked a passion he couldn't ignore. After serving in the Royal Military Police, where he honed his skills in security and logistics, he transitioned to motorsport security, working his way up through various racing series. His meticulous approach and ability to anticipate potential threats quickly earned him a reputation for reliability. 

At ART Grand Prix, Rhys is responsible for overseeing all security measures, from pit lane safety to paddock access. He believes in a proactive security strategy, emphasizing preventative measures and thorough risk assessments. What sets Rhys apart is his uncanny ability to remain calm and decisive even in the most chaotic situations, a trait that has earned him the respect of the entire team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Rhys is a sturdy man of average height with a watchful gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during races.
Insists on performing a thorough security check of his office every morning.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office.
